name: Augur Cassia
notes: AC 12 (15 with mage armor). Augur assigned to the fort. Knows far more than she reveals. Troubled.
gm_notes: Objective: prevent the spear from leaving the vault. Goal: make the party understand what it is before it's too late. Agenda: appear to cooperate with Corvinus while sabotaging his plan. Secret: she is partially shadow-touched herself from years of augury near the spear. Knows what the spear is. Knows what it wants. Knows what she is.
objective: Prevent the spear from leaving the vault under any circumstances.
goal: Make the party understand what the spear is before it is too late.
agenda: Appear to cooperate with Corvinus while actively sabotaging his plan.
secret: Partially shadow-touched herself from years of augury near the spear.
